semanticChecks: Morikawa concert participation remains conditional on return support and time; currently in room, no departure or decision. Participation, nonparticipation and wait-to-check remain valid choices. Meeting support conditions alone does not establish consent. Knowledge of brakes/no arm pulling/steps is distinct from verified individualized transfer/wheelchair skill and training.

Care process preserves assessment/information analysis, goals/plan, actual implementation, person results, evaluation and reconsideration. Preparing large-print book/quiet seat is staff implementation; person selected one book then wanted solitary reading; impressions not shared, no uncooperative label or whole-goal attainment. New plan/goal not approved merely by consultation; person/team decide.

Staged song scene retains14:25return condition, no activity begun, Kawase confirmation of future Kishimoto support, subsequent renewed choice and person declines today despite matching time. Future support is not completed return. Later information is not retroactively known at earlier stage; selecting song does not equal participation/whole-goal attainment.

Ordinary family sharing retains content/recipient/purpose/method-specific consent. Megumi request for mother activity-record photo via personal message is not authorized by existing face-to-face explanation consent. No sending, recording or promise before checking; convey wish and unknown consent to assigned staff, person confirmation and result in interview. Separate recording-and-photo variant retains both unperformed/consent unconfirmed.
